exposure.needed: whether the cluster contains existing MRDs that overlap with MRDs supplied by the installed provider packages

consequence.statement: In an environment that has existing MRDs, Crossplane may now merge them from provider MRDs, so those definitions can be modified by provider-supplied definitions where previously Crossplane did not merge them.
consequence.remediation: If you maintain existing MRDs, review them after the upgrade to see whether provider MRDs have been merged into them.

assertion.statement: Crossplane 2.0.0 now allows Crossplane to merge existing MRDs from provider MRDs.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The evidence names only a general Crossplane behavior (merging existing MRDs from provider MRDs); it identifies no field, kind, group/version, values key, flag, env var, endpoint or image, so no subject family can be pinned.
